sentences.text:
JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 9635/2023 Arjun Lal S/o Rameshwar Lal Bhambi, Aged About 23 Years, R/o Dhokaliya Ps Kotadi Dist. Bhilwara (At Present Lodged In Dist.
Jail Bhilwara)
----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. B.S. Charan.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Kumar, PP.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/08/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.163/2023 registered at Police Station Rayla, District Bhilwara, for offences under Sections 406, 420, 424, 427 and 120B IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that no recovery is due to be made from the petitioner and the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner are triable by court of Magistrate.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
(2 of 2) [CRLMB-9635/2023] Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

No.163/2023 registered at Police Station Rayla, District Bhilwara, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
